notes.page_content: The author continues a class-count argument, then writes an underlined Lemme giving a form for classes of Pi_I with the upper round mark. The author writes the count (n-1)+2=n+1=card I+1 and the parenthetical statement that this also completes the induction on the number of classes. The lemma names complements of indexed unions of Sigma_alpha-plus cup E_alpha, the membership condition in pi_0(X setminus E_alpha), and pairwise disjointness of the hatted sets. The final written double arrow relates the hatted and un-hatted disjointness expressions. These are attributed manuscript assertions; this reading establishes no proof of them.
